commercial_building_character: Mostly residential with scattered small industrial areas in the northwest and northeast; historically a pastoral, residential and industrial township with market gardens. Springvale has a major retail/commercial shopping strip (noted for its Vietnamese/Asian retail precinct, though Wikipedia intro emphasises residential+industrial mix).
source_quotes: Springvale (Boonwurrung: Monite) is a suburb in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, 22 km (14 mi) south-east of Melbourne's Central Business District, located within the City of Greater Dandenong local government area. Springvale recorded a population of 22,174 at the 2021 census.
At the outbreak of the Second World War, Springvale was a pastoral, residential and industrial township with market gardens in the surrounding areas.
The suburb is mostly residential, although some small industrial areas are scattered through the suburb's northwest and northeast.
